_doc: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for Vast.ai spend ceilings (P14: correlated values defined once).
Read by exactly two consumers, so the numbers cannot drift:
2. src/limits.ts                  — via readFileSync at module load
A test asserts both readers agree. Change a number HERE and nowhere else.
NOTE: OPA mounts a --data JSON at the ROOT of `data`, ignoring filename and
directory. The `vast_spend_limits` wrapper key below IS the mount path:
data.vast_spend_limits.*  — without it these keys would collide with package names.

_semantics.maxConcurrentInstances: At most this many rentals held AT ONCE, counted across the whole account (foreign/unlabelled boxes included — they bill the same card). Renting while already holding this many is denied.
_semantics.maxDphPerInstance: STRICTLY less than. An offer at exactly this price is DENIED. Applies to the Vast.ai `dph_total` field, which is the all-in hourly price of one instance.
_semantics.maxLifetimeMinutes: Reaper destroys a rental older than this regardless of health.
_semantics.minCreditFloorUsd: Refuse to rent when remaining credit is at or below this.
